title: Efficient Learning of Survival Analysis Models Under Outcome-Dependent Truncation and Censoring
abstract: arXiv:2610.12538v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern machine learning models are typically trained on data assumed to be representative of the predictive tasks the model will face in the future, but practical datasets violate this assumption. We focus on outcome-dependent truncation in which an observation appears in the training data depending on its label. Our work connects two largely distinct literatures: efficient learning under truncation and survival analysis. Existing methods for truncated survival analysis do not characterize the optimization landscape and instead rely on iterative procedures such as expectation maximization. We address this gap and prove that Cox regression can be efficiently learned under truncated and right-censored data using first-order optimization when the baseline hazard is known (despite nonconvexity). translated_title: 结果依赖截断与删失下生存分析模型的高效学习
translated_abstract: 现代机器学习模型通常是在假设训练数据能够代表模型未来所面对的预测任务的前提下进行训练的，但实际数据集往往违背这一假设。我们关注结果依赖的截断问题，即一个观测是否出现在训练数据中取决于其标签值。我们的工作连接了两个基本相互独立的文献领域：截断数据下的高效学习与生存分析。现有的截断生存分析方法并未刻画优化问题的整体结构（优化景观），而是依赖于期望最大化（EM）等迭代算法。我们填补了这一空白，证明了当基线风险函数已知时（尽管问题是非凸的），Cox回归可以在截断和右删失数据下通过一阶优化方法被高效学习。相反，当基线风险函数需要联合学习时，我们构建了可识别且设定正确的模型，其负对数似然……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文证明了在结果依赖的截断和右删失数据下，当基线风险函数已知时，非凸的Cox回归可以通过一阶优化方法高效学习，并为需要联合学习基线风险函数的情形构建了可识别且设定正确的模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that Cox regression, despite nonconvexity, can be efficiently learned via first-order optimization under outcome-dependent truncation and right-censoring when the baseline hazard is known, and constructs identifiable, correctly specified models for the case where the baseline hazard is learned jointly.
